Cape Breton Faces Recovery After Devastating Storm and Flooding

Cape Breton Island, Nova Scotia, is undertaking recovery efforts following a devastating storm that caused widespread flooding. The storm brought heavy rainfall, leading to significant damage and prompting emergency responses. One woman's death has been reported in connection with the event, sending shockwaves across the region. Emergency personnel described chaotic conditions, with vehicles hydroplaning. Environment Canada has forecast more heavy rainfall for parts of the island as rebuilding efforts commence.
